newsitem.title: USA: COHR names Morford president, COO.
newsitem.headline: COHR names Morford president, COO.

text.p: COHR Inc said Sandy Morford was named president and chief operating officer.
The title of president was previously held by Paul Chopra, who remains chairman and chief executive officer. The position of chief operating officer is newly-created.

Sandy Morford was been with COHR for 17 years. In his new positions, he will head both COHR's operating divisions -- COHR MasterPlan and Purchase Connection -- as well as its security, insurance and consulting businesses.
COHR, an outsourcing company, provides equipment, servicing, group purchasing and other products and services to hospitals, integrated health systems and alternate site providers.
